span.p:
Shared Project Core

span.p:
same repository ≠ same capabilities
subagent done ≠ integrated
worktree isolated ≠ external state isolated

Context Read Protocol

Input Snapshot + Task Contract

span.p:
Source Tool Adapter Profile

span.p:
Target Tool Adapter Profile

span.p:
Capability Difference Record

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Local Work + Validation Evidence

span.p:
Handoff Package
draft / delivered / blocked / superseded

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
cross-tool handoff delivered
≠ integrated or resumable

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
State Conflict Record

span.p:
needs_rework / repository_validation_required
退回责任阶段补证

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
integrated_snapshot_ready

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Resume Gate
已集成快照能否支持下一任务？

span.p:
needs_context

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
capability_review_required

span.p:
state_conflict

span.p:
validation_required

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
human_decision_required

span.p:
ready_to_resume
只允许领取下一项局部任务

ready_to_resume
≠ execution_started
